title: FundPG
tagline: We allow individuals to allocate a percentage of yield to public goods using scaling solutions
description:
The current state of public goods funding doesn't scale. In an effort to create more ways to fund public goods bottom up we created a protocol that allows you to reroute your yield to public goods via the Gitcoin Matching Pool. 

Our goal here at Scaling Ethereum is to build out this solution on multiple different scaling solutions creating more ways to fund public goods.

Our take is 0% on all products and partnerships so we will rely entirely on public goods funding to further funding public goods.
how_its_made:
We created a no-loss donation pool that routes the yield allocated to the Gitcoin Matching Pool. We added several scaling solutions during this hackathon to increase our suite of products that allow individuals to fund public goods.
